description: Field specification, NOT a completed run or synthetic success receipt. Populate from actual execution.

required_fields.workers: actual delegation IDs, roles, served model IDs and artifact paths
required_fields.contract_commit: full exact accepted C0 commit; C0 names its own candidate
required_fields.dependency_commits: map of required accepted dependency IDs to exact commits
required_fields.candidate_commit: full exact Git commit or explicit null when no candidate exists
required_fields.requirements: every brief requirement ID with passed/failed/not_run and evidence paths
required_fields.tests: full command, cwd, interpreter, exit code, test totals, stdout artifact path
required_fields.behaviour: actual inputs/condition, observations, outcome, trace paths and known limits
required_fields.review: non-author identity, exact candidate, verdict/findings, complete plain-source visibility and report path; explicit null if missing
required_fields.resources: actual usage/cost or explicit unknown; no invented zero
required_fields.artifacts: absolute paths with SHA-256 and source/input identity

ready_gate: All declared feature requirements are passed with existing actual evidence; real dependency path exercised; source committed; fresh complete-source non-author review accepted; Sol first-hand checks done. Otherwise use non-ready status. Model-study completion requires its separate admission and actual data.
